name: Aba-Loria
summary: Aba-Loria is an Ayleid ruin in central Coldharbour, east of the Spurned Peak containing Worm Cultists and skeletons. They are led by Cirterisse. A copy of Necromancy: The Great Debate can be found on an altar within the ruins. Fleshflies and rats are found in numbers within. The Forsaken Village is nearby.
notes: Salache Bonelords and Salache Cryomages used to be found here until Update 11.
